title: Repair and Parts Guarantee Periods (Repair and Emergency Service Calls)
content:
Harbison guarantees the labor on completed repairs and the parts it supplies for a fixed number of calendar days in every call class of Repair and Emergency Service Calls.

| Call class | Repair (labor) guarantee | Harbison-supplied parts guarantee |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Evening Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Weekend Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days |

The repair guarantee is the number of calendar days after a repair is completed during which a return visit for the same failure is free. The parts guarantee is the number of calendar days after the repair is completed during which a Harbison-supplied part that fails is replaced free. Both periods are the same, 365 days, whichever class the repair was done in.
